title: DNA and RNA Stabilization
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be2pjgdn
materials: Do not freeze samples in stabilization solution immediately.

steps.title: Prepare stabilization solution
steps.instruction: Combine 935 mL autoclaved MilliQ water with 700 g ammonium sulfate; stir until dissolved. Add 25 mL of 1 M sodium citrate and 40 mL of 0.5 M EDTA. Adjust pH to 5.2 with concentrated H₂SO₄. Bring final volume to 1.5 L with autoclaved MilliQ water. Store at room temperature; if precipitation occurs, heat to 37 °C and agitate until redissolved.

steps.title: Do not freeze tissues before immersion
steps.instruction: Never freeze tissue before immersion in the DNA/RNA stabilization solution; use the solution only with fresh tissue.

steps.title: Add stabilization solution to microtube
steps.instruction: Add the prepared stabilization solution to an appropriate 1.5 mL microtube, using a minimum tissue‑to‑solution volume ratio of 1:5 (tissue : solution).

steps.title: Cut tissue and transfer to tube
steps.instruction: Cut large tissue pieces to approximately 3 mm in any dimension and transfer them into the microtube containing the stabilization solution.

steps.title: Store tubes at 4 °C overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 4 °C overnight to allow thorough penetration of the solution into the tissue.

steps.title: Do not rinse stabilization solution
steps.instruction: Do not rinse the stabilization solution from samples before downstream DNA or RNA extraction, as DNase/RNase inactivation is reversible.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue rapidly
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue quickly once it is in the lysis/denaturation solution to proceed with nucleic acid extraction.

steps.title: Remove excess stabilization solution
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, remove excess stabilization solution from the tube, then wipe the tube with an absorbent lab wipe or paper towel to eliminate as much residual solution as possible before extraction.

substeps.instruction: Wipe tube with absorbent lab wipe or paper towel
